notes: DealerCenter/DWS WordPress build. Cards draw photos as role=img divs with data-background-image; the stock number lives in data-vehicle-stock-no and matches the VDP URL's last segment (/inventory/{make}/{model}/{stock}/). VDP gallery is .dws-vdp-media-container img (UniteGallery on this build) with data-pin-media full-size URLs; on imagescf.dealercenter.net the leading /{w}/{h}/ numeric pair is a rendition and /320/240/ is the related-cars rail size.
